category: Data Processing Policies, Processes, and Procedures (CT.PO-P)
subcategory_text: A data life cycle to manage data is aligned and implemented with the system development life cycle to manage systems.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SA-3 (System Development Life Cycle), PM-7 (Enterprise Architecture)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.27 (Secure system architecture and engineering principles)
GDPR Art. 25 (Data protection by design and by default)
implementation_examples: Align the data lifecycle (purpose, collection, use, retention, sharing, deletion) with the system development lifecycle so that data-handling capabilities and decommissioning are addressed at the same architectural touchpoints as security
Document the lifecycle-to-SDLC mapping and reuse it across projects
Re-examine alignment when data classes or system platforms change
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the data lifecycle is aligned with the system development lifecycle
Determine whether the mapping is documented and reused
Determine whether decommissioning and deletion are explicit lifecycle phases
Determine whether alignment is refreshed on platform or data-class change
